cases.text:
Unfortunately, same-day delivery is not something I can find in our policies. Per **kb/02-shipping-policy.md**, Trailforge offers only three shipping methods:

- **Standard Ground**: 5–7 business days — $5.95 (free on orders over $75)
- **Expedited**: 2–3 business days — $12.95
- **Overnight**: Next business day (order by 1 PM local time) — $24.95

Same-day delivery is not a service we have documented. If you need the fastest option available, **Overnight** shipping (ordered before 1 PM local time) would be your best bet.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
